WITH rating_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    AVG(replacement_cost) as avg_replacement_cost,
    AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) as avg_daily_price
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
),
cross_rating_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_daily_price) as overall_avg_daily_price
  FROM rating_stats
),
filtered_ratings AS (
  SELECT 
    avg_replacement_cost,
    avg_daily_price
  FROM rating_stats rs
  CROSS JOIN cross_rating_avg cra
  WHERE rs.avg_daily_price > cra.overall_avg_daily_price
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_replacement_cost) as avg_replacement_cost,
  AVG(avg_daily_price) as avg_daily_price,
  AVG(avg_daily_price - (SELECT overall_avg_daily_price FROM cross_rating_avg)) as avg_excess
FROM filtered_ratings
